verdict.rationale: Sakana Marlin is a SaaS research product, so API parity with the UI is a fair question, but the evidence only describes a UI-driven workflow, pricing and credits, and never mentions a public API. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, so nothing shows that UI capabilities are exposed programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
